note: Static analysis only. A PORTABLE classification is a hypothesis until the migration actually runs against PostgreSQL 17; see migration/tools/verify-portability.mjs.

auth_uid.why: Requires the auth.uid() compatibility function backed by transaction-local state (migration/sql/001).

supabase_roles.why: Grants to Supabase role names. Portable once roles of the same name are created in Cloud SQL — required, because Phase 1 guards compare current_user against them.

auth_users_fk.why: FK to the Supabase-owned auth.users table. Requires the application-owned auth.users shim to exist first (migration/sql/001).

storage_objects.why: Supabase models object storage as Postgres tables with RLS. Cloud Storage has no equivalent; these policies must be re-expressed as Security Rules or backend-signed access.

supabase_realtime.why: Supabase Realtime publication. No Cloud SQL analogue.

extensions_schema.why: Supabase installs extensions into a dedicated "extensions" schema. Cloud SQL installs into public (or a schema you create).

supabase_admin_role.why: References the Supabase superuser role by name. Cloud SQL has no supabase_admin; the Phase 1 trigger guards test current_user against it.

auth_users_read.why: Reads auth.users directly. Satisfied by the shim table, but the columns it selects must exist there.

markers.why: Requires the auth.uid() compatibility function backed by transaction-local state (migration/sql/001).
